title: Kusoma kwa Ufahamu (Theme 5: Kukabiliana na umaskini)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child counts mizani by syllables (every syllable ends in a vowel) and finds vina at the middle and the end of each line.
representations: vina coloured at the middle and end
steps: Find the last syllable of each half (vina).
contexts: facing poverty: a poem on hard work

board.do: Bidii ni kazi yetu, tufanye bila uvivu

board.say: Vina vya mshororo huu ni vipi?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child counts the mizani of two lines and marks the vina.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mshororo "Mama anapika" una mizani mingapi?" Kwa nini "2" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Mizani ni silabi, yaani sehemu za sauti. Hesabu silabi (ma-ma a-na-pi-ka), si maneno.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mshororo "Nenda shule" una mizani mingapi?" Kwa nini "10" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Mizani si herufi. Kwa kawaida kila irabu huanza silabi: ne-nda shu-le ni mizani 5.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Vina vya mishororo hii ni vipi?" Kwa nini "ma-" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Vina ni sauti za mwisho zinazofanana katika mishororo. Tazama mwisho wa kila mshororo.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mishororo "shambani" na "nyumbani" ina vina vipi?" Kwa nini "hakuna" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Vina ni sauti za mwisho zinazofanana, si neno lilelile. Shambani na nyumbani zina vina -ani.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mshororo "Soma kwa bidii" una mizani mingapi?" Kwa nini "5" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kila irabu ni silabi tofauti: bidii ni bi-di-i, yaani mizani 3. Hesabu kila irabu.

checks.question: Mizani ya "Kazi ni uhai" ni mingapi?
Vina hupatikana wapi katika mshororo?
checks.answer: mwisho wa kipande cha kwanza na cha pili
